support_notes.hf: Not in the HF lineup here. Use the GGUF nodes for this model.
support_notes.gguf: Hard toggle via enable_thinking. Pair the vision node with the matching mmproj file.
support_notes.soft_switch: No official /think or /no_think soft switch for this family.

notes: Provider says keep at least 128K context to preserve thinking quality.
Q4_K_P is the best quality-size starting point; move to Q6_K_P or Q8_K_P when VRAM allows.
IQ quants are fallback options when you cannot fit Q4_K_M or Q4_K_P.

support_notes.hf: Hard toggle via enable_thinking when the backend honors the chat template.
support_notes.gguf: Hard toggle via enable_thinking in the Qwen chat template.
support_notes.soft_switch: No official /think or /no_think soft switch for Qwen3.5.

notes: For precise coding, Qwen recommends temperature 0.6 with thinking still enabled.
For hard non-thinking reasoning tasks, Qwen recommends top_p 1.0 and top_k 40 when the backend exposes them.
Provider says keep at least 128K context to preserve thinking capability and use 32K+ output budget when possible.

support_notes.hf: Hard toggle via enable_thinking, with /think and /no_think available as soft switches.
support_notes.gguf: Hard toggle via enable_thinking. /think and /no_think are available only on Qwen3 chat-template builds.
support_notes.soft_switch: Qwen3 officially supports /think and /no_think when thinking is enabled.

notes: Qwen warns against greedy decoding for thinking mode because it can repeat or degrade quality.
Provider recommends 32K output budget for most tasks and only enabling YaRN when you really need longer than the native 32K context.
For harder reasoning benchmarks, Qwen suggests stretching output budget beyond 32K if your backend allows it.

support_notes.hf: Gemma 4 supports configurable thinking, but current repo behavior can vary by backend.
support_notes.gguf: Use the settings manually and verify behavior in RAW_TRACE because GGUF support varies by backend.
support_notes.soft_switch: Gemma uses chat-template thinking controls instead of /think or /no_think.

notes: Gemma 4 uses one standardized sampler for both thinking and non-thinking modes.
Official context target is 256K on 26B A4B and 31B variants.
If the backend does not expose top_k, keep temperature and top_p at the official defaults.

notes: Gemma 4 uses one standardized sampler for both thinking and non-thinking modes.
